user.title: Energy Cost
user.description: Turn cumulative energy sensors into money using your electricity tariff.

data_description.import_energy_entity: Cumulative grid import sensor in kWh (state class total_increasing).
data_description.export_energy_entity: Optional cumulative grid export sensor in kWh.
data_description.pv_energy_entity: Optional cumulative PV production sensor in kWh, used to calculate savings.
data_description.tariff_mode: Single-zone uses one price; dual-zone switches between day and night prices.
data_description.price_single: Price per kWh for the single-zone tariff.
data_description.price_day: Price per kWh during the day for the dual-zone tariff.
data_description.price_night: Price per kWh during the night for the dual-zone tariff.
data_description.night_start: Local time when the night tariff starts.
data_description.night_end: Local time when the night tariff ends.
data_description.export_price: Revenue per kWh exported to the grid; use 0 when export is not compensated.
data_description.currency: Symbol shown on all money sensors, for example ₴.
data_description.month_start_day: Day of the month when the billing period starts (1-28).

error.invalid_entity: Select a sensor entity that exists.
error.invalid_unit: The sensor must report energy in kWh, Wh or MWh.

abort.already_configured: Energy Cost is already configured for this import sensor.
